name: Nanjou Ryuusei
source:
He works at the company of his father, who is in the cult's upper echelon, but he is extremely timid and deals with stress daily.
He and Yurina divorced when Kiseki was young.

"I'm so happy you brought a friend along."

[Translated from the [url=https://www.otomate.jp/sullyland/chara/?page=12]official website[/url]]
